evidence.detail: neither NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS nor NAPI_DISABLE_CPP_EXCEPTIONS is defined anywhere in the real build config; no -fno-exceptions/-EHs-c- override is set

absent either macro, C++ exceptions are enabled by default if the compiler itself was built with exceptions on (the near-universal C++ default absent an explicit -fno-exceptions, which this project's CMakeLists.txt does not set)
